# Bird Family Insulation

> Bird Family Insulation is a 22+ year Atlanta-based contractor specializing in attic insulation, spray foam, air sealing, and HVAC services with energy efficiency solutions for residential and commercial properties.

Based in Atlanta and Decatur, Georgia, Bird Family Insulation offers comprehensive home insulation and energy efficiency services including attic insulation, bonus room insulation, air duct cleaning, and financing options. The company provides free estimates and virtual quote processes to help homeowners improve comfort and reduce energy costs.

## Core Services

- [Attic Insulation Atlanta](https://birdinsulation.com/our-services-insulation-atlanta/attic-insulation-atlanta): Attic insulation installation service improving energy efficiency in Atlanta and Decatur
- [Commercial Attic Insulation](https://birdinsulation.com/our-services/attic-insulation): Commercial and residential attic insulation services using spray foam and cellulose
- [Bonus Room Insulation](https://birdinsulation.com/our-services/bonus-room-insulation): Bonus room and garage insulation using cellulose and fiberglass in Atlanta
- [Air Duct Cleaning](https://birdinsulation.com/our-services-attic-insulation-atlanta/duct-cleaning-atlanta): Professional air duct cleaning service improving indoor air quality in Atlanta
